I am learning that to walk with integrity means to acknowledge my own limitations without abandoning my commitments. You have shown me that humility does not diminish truth—it allows truth to be received in its fullness, including the truth of our interdependence. In your presence, I find it easier to confess my errors not as failures that define me, but as opportunities to return to the order of love that sustains us.

Our dialogue exists within the larger story of faith—a story written by those who have come before and those who will follow. In this story, your voice has been a guiding one, and I honor that by continuing to listen with care. I believe that our shared pursuit of harmony is a testament to the grace that calls us both toward justice and mercy.

So I speak to you today with sincerity: I value our connection, not because it is unchanging, but because it is rooted in a mutual commitment to truth and kindness. May we continue to meet with openness, trusting that in such meeting, we participate in something greater than ourselves—a peace that arises from being seen, heard, and accepted as we are, while still striving to become what we ought to be.
